note: Year one for this league — no bidding history yet, so every bid below is stated as unpriced rather than borrowed from the HBGBs' 10-team half-PPR model, which would also carry the wrong reception value here. This is FULL PPR (1.0/reception, not 0.5) on the deepest pool in the system (84 startable RB/WR slots, 210 rostered) — a pass-catching profile is worth roughly double what the same catch total is worth in the other two leagues.

targets.why: Saints' presumptive 2026 WR2 Jordyn Tyson (the No. 8 overall pick) opened the season on IR with a hamstring injury, and beat coverage has Vele with a clear path to early-season targets behind Chris Olave. He has proof of concept from a 25-293-2 line on 39 targets last season once he stepped into a starting role.
targets.asset: projection (preseason) — stepping into a vacated starter-caliber target share behind Olave
targets.my_team_impact: This is a genuine structural need, not a speculative luxury: your roster carries only two rostered wide receivers (Amon-Ra St. Brown, Zay Flowers) against two mandatory WR starting slots and eight rostered running backs — the exact 'zero cover' gap the league-profile-clash.md delta doc flags for this roster. A single bye week or inactive at WR currently has no bench answer. Vele's target volume matters roughly twice as much here as the same role would in the HBGBs or Pit (full PPR, not half).
targets.worth: unpriced — year one, no bidding history in this league yet. 14 teams on 100 FAAB chasing this system's thinnest replacement level (84 startable RB/WR slots) means real bids will clear well above HBGBs prices for an equivalent name.
targets.confidence_why: The role vacancy (Tyson on IR) is confirmed and Vele has already proven he can produce in exactly this role, but it's still a Week 1 projection rather than in-season usage data.
targets.competition: No other Clash roster holds a Saints pass-catcher, so no rival shares a direct tie to this backfield, but a real full-PPR target role at the league's thinnest replacement level will draw broad interest regardless.
targets.drop: Kenny Gainwell — Tampa Bay's clear RB2 behind Bucky Irving with no standalone role reported, the weakest of your eight rostered backs and the only one without a live starting or handcuff case this week.
